column1: # Registry of WITHDRAWN FIGURES — consumed by scripts/doc_gates.sh (GATE 27).
# WHY THIS IS SEPARATE FROM RETRACTED_FIGURES.tsv (GATE 3b)
#   GATE 3b requires a content-anchored allowlist row for EVERY occurrence, deliberately —
#   "no auto-exemption" — which is right for small statistics with a handful of mentions.
#   The project's LARGEST withdrawals are not like that: "3×10³⁷" alone has 40 occurrences
#   across 14 files, nearly all of them legitimate prose already carrying a marker. Forcing
#   40 hand-anchored allowlist rows would make the registry unmaintainable, and that is why
#   the headline 2026-08-24 withdrawal was never registered at all — leaving the biggest
#   retraction in the project unguarded (Q-342).
# THE RULE HERE IS WEAKER AND CHEAPER, ON PURPOSE: a line that states a withdrawn figure
# must also carry a supersession marker ON THAT LINE. It cannot judge whether the marker is
# apt — GATE 3b does that for the figures it covers — but it catches the case that matters
# for a merge: a line reintroducing a withdrawn figure with NO marker at all.
# MEASURED NEED (2026-08-28): merging origin/v4-query-program would restore
# enumeration/LEADERBOARD.md lines 3 and 170, which carry ≈3×10³⁷ with ZERO markers, silently
# undoing commit b8d45b5e. Both doc_gates retract-figures and canonical-ceiling PASS on that
# reverted file. This gate is the one that does not.
# figure <TAB> why it is withdrawn
